diagnosis.classification: real candidate test-source lifecycle fixture failure; not Gradle harness/OOM
diagnosis.cause: The real Spring fixture registered ChatConversationArchiveSchemaInitializer but did not activate its @ConditionalOnProperty contract. Configuration processing excluded the archive InitializingBean, so readiness was never invoked before ApplicationRunner ordering and archive drift validation never ran.
supporting_observations: Both ordering failures reached ChatDeliberationSchemaInitializer.run during SpringApplication.callRunners with coreReady=false.
archiveIndexDriftStillFailsClosedAfterSourcesBecomeReady observed no exception, consistent with the archive initializer not running.
The test default properties previously set only spring.main.banner-mode.
The archive initializer is conditional on chat.conversation-archive.enabled=true.

correction.scope: one owned lifecycle test source only
correction.change: Add chat.conversation-archive.enabled=true to SpringApplication default properties.
correction.expected_effect: The conditional archive InitializingBean participates in actual context refresh, calls ChatSchemaReadiness before source validation/DDL, and leaves subsequent core/deliberation ApplicationRunner calls as no-op schema migrations.
